name: The Showdown: Gorilla vs 100
storyline:
You are the gorilla.
They are the 100 men.
Only one side walks away.

The Showdown: Gorilla vs. 100 is a chaotic, over-the-top roguelike/roguelite brawler where you take on wave after wave of determined (but mostly doomed) human opponents. With physics-driven ragdoll mayhem, every punch, throw, and slam is uniquely hilarious and brutally satisfying.

Why fight 100 men?
Because the internet won't stop arguing about it.
Because science won't answer the question.
Because you're a gorilla—and gorillas don't need a reason.
summary: A physics-based roguelike brawler where you play as a gorilla smashing your way through 100 men. Punch, throw, and ragdoll your enemies in chaotic, ever-changing game. Easy to pick up, wild to watch, and built to settle the internet’s dumbest debate.
